zh.title: WBC Sim-to-Real 真机部署与夹爪集成
zh.summary: 完成了 Whole-Body Control（WBC）项目从仿真环境到宇树 G1 真机的初步部署，并开展 Sim-to-Real 测试，打通真机运行流程。在此基础上，将自制二指夹爪集成至 G1，并通过机器人板载控制系统完成夹爪驱动与功能测试，使后续任务能够直接调用夹爪。该阶段为控制参数调试、系统稳定性优化及 GR00T N1.7 相关实验奠定了硬件与控制基础。

en.title: WBC Sim-to-Real Deployment and Gripper Integration on Unitree G1
en.summary: I completed the initial deployment of a Whole-Body Control (WBC) project from simulation to a Unitree G1 and carried out Sim-to-Real testing, establishing the real-robot execution pipeline. I then integrated my custom two-finger gripper with the G1 and used its onboard control system to drive and functionally test the gripper, enabling it to be called directly in future tasks. This work establishes a hardware and control foundation for parameter tuning, system stability improvements, and future GR00T N1.7 experiments.
